P2.message: Maximum number of function evaluations has been exceeded.

protocol: Training seeds 200000+ (100/family); selection 190000+ (exactly10/family); ID110000+ (20/family), OOD115000+/120000+/125000+ (20/family/profile, max seed129019). No final130000+ cohort accessed. The OOD125000 block is separate from FINAL and stops before130000. Each new model has at most61 validation looks (GP one); P0r61, P1 61, NN≤61epochs with12epoch patience and16384 sampled windows/epoch. All models see the same causal eta and measurement-variance sequences; GP/NN use63 samples, IMM recursively summarizes history. No evaluation tuning.
offset_diagnostics_definition: Local horizon error = (prediction-current measured eta) - (surface(t+12ms)+tau*surface_dot(t+12ms)-surface(t)). Oracle increment error = diff(prediction)-diff(physical target), excluding tracker resets. Segment-centered error removes one best-fit constant per reset segment for diagnosis only (uses future labels, never control or selection). None changes the original absolute target or validation criterion.
covariance_note: IMM target variance includes posterior state covariance, between-mode covariance and the frozen-mode white-jerk/snap forecast variance integrated to12ms for f+tau*f_dot. Stationary-mode position random-walk variance is scaled by the horizon. It does not include stiffness/contact bias or mode switches during the forecast horizon. Adding process variance changes only reported coverage, never means, fitted parameters or feed-forward.
protocol_correction: An initial implementation used50 native+50 augmented validation scenes. After discovering the mismatch, selection was replayed with ONLY50 native190000+ scenes. Architecture, training inputs, all61 prespecified IMM candidates, GP optimization and network update trajectory were unchanged; no pilot ID/OOD/closed-loop result was used to add or alter candidates. Initial labels also had an implementation sign error, corrected and independently checked against Oracle before fitting the delivered models. Final numbers use corrected labels and the exact50-scene validation set. This is exploratory diagnostic work, not a preregistered confirmatory evaluation. The correction repeated computation (same candidate sets), and that cost is not hidden as a single executed pass.
